'''International relations'''
*[[Germany–Russia relations]]
**[[Russia]] withdraws from its military technical cooperation agreement with [[Germany]]. [https://kyivindependent.com/moscow-withdraws-from-military-cooperation-agreement-with-germany/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')]
 
'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 South Korean martial law crisis]]
**The [[Judiciary of South Korea|Seoul Central District Court]] rejects former [[President of South Korea|president]] [[Yoon Suk Yeol]]'s petition to release him due to an unreasonable request more than a week after he was [[Arrest of Yoon Suk Yeol|re-arrested]] on charges related to a failed [[martial law]] attempt on December 3, 2024. [https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10535061 (''The Korea Herald'')]
*[[March 2025 American deportations of Venezuelans]]
**The governments of [[El Salvador]], the United States, and [[Venezuela]] conduct a prisoner swap involving over 200 Venezuelans incarcerated at the [[Terrorism Confinement Center]] in exchange for the release of ten Americans from Venezuelan custody. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/el-salvador-send-detained-venezuelans-home-swap-americans-sources-say-2025-07-18/ (Reuters)]
*[[Political ineligibility of Jair Bolsonaro]]
**The [[Supreme Federal Court]] of [[Brazil]] orders former [[Brazilian President|president]] [[Jair Bolsonaro]] to wear an [[electronic tagging|electronic ankle bracelet]] and places him on nightly [[house arrest]], and forbids him from approaching embassies, foreign ambassadors, and diplomats. [https://apnews.com/article/brazil-bolsonaro-investigation-supreme-court-b1e2c1fbb7f776103895b6efca94af4f (AP)]
*The United States government declares the [[Pakistan]]i militant group [[The Resistance Front]] a [[List of designated terrorist groups|terrorist group]] after it committed [[2025 Pahalgam attack|an attack]] in [[Pahalgam]] in April. [https://www.dw.com/en/us-designates-pahalgam-attackers-as-terrorist-organization/a-73318926 (DW)]
